import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
import click

group = click.Group('cli', commands={
    'visible': click.Command('visible', help='Visible help'),
    'hidden': click.Command('hidden', help='Hidden help', hidden=True),
})
ctx = click.Context(group)
for kwargs, expected_hidden in [({}, False), ({'include_hidden': False}, False), ({'include_hidden': True}, True)]:
    formatter = click.HelpFormatter()
    group.format_commands(ctx, formatter, **kwargs)
    text = formatter.getvalue()
    assert 'Commands:' in text and 'visible' in text, text
    assert ('hidden' in text) == expected_hidden, text
try:
    group.format_commands(ctx, click.HelpFormatter(), True)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('include_hidden must be keyword-only')
print('Help formatting checks passed')

@'
import difflib
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/click/core.py')
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:src/click/core.py']).splitlines(keepends=True)
current = p.read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)
a = [line.rstrip(b'\r\n') for line in original]
b = [line.rstrip(b'\r\n') for line in current]
result = []
for tag, i, j, k, l in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b, autojunk=False).get_opcodes():
    if tag == 'equal':
        result.extend(original[i:j])
    else:
        result.extend(line + b'\n' for line in b[k:l])
p.write_bytes(b''.join(result))
'@ | python -B -; git diff --check; git --no-pager diff --stat; git status --short
arguments.description: Preserve original unchanged line endings and check final diff
